evidence.reason: Lines 712-715 spawn the child and call recorder.append before the try at line 716. If append raises, control never enters the existing except/finally cleanup, so the child is not terminated/reaped and the log descriptor is not closed; the spawned process can outlive the failed boot. Moving the append inside the existing try (before waiting for qemu.pid) lets the existing cleanup stop/terminate/reap the child and close the log via finally, without adding new requirements.
